desc: Ideation complete: reachable strings are exactly all ordered parenthesis trees with the same unordered rooted tree shape; the count is the product over all nodes of multinomial factors for child isomorphism classes.

Implement deterministic canonical-ID algorithm in Python: stack-parse S into children lists, process nodes bottom-up, intern sorted child canonical IDs, compute factorial/invfactorial modulo 998244353, and multiply each node's multinomial factor including the super-root.
Verify the implementation on the samples and edge cases: single pair, repeated identical subtrees, deep chains, multiple top-level trees, and maximum-size balanced strings.
